title: VendPoint Program Fees — Shortfall, Badge, Data and Event Fees
content:
Rules for the program fees of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program.

**F1 Shortfall fee.** For each calendar month after the ramp-up months full months following the installation month, a machine whose net vend value for the month is below its minimum monthly usage is charged a shortfall fee of the shortfall fee rate percent of the shortfall, rounded half up to the cent and capped at the monthly fee cap, unless the site is pooled under the pooled site minimum; where the model tests the minimum in credit-hold months, months the machine was locked under a credit hold are tested like any other month.

**F2 Badge and data fees.** Active badge users above the included badge users, counted as the distinct badges with at least one vend dated in the month, are charged the additional badge fee each for the month; a cellular-connected machine is charged the cellular data fee for the month.

**F3 Once a month.** Each monthly fee type (shortfall fee, badge fee, cellular data fee) is charged at most once per machine per billing month.

**F4 Event fees.** A relocation beyond the included relocations in the rolling 12 months carries the relocation fee; a model swap carries the model swap fee; an emergency restock carries the emergency restock fee; a replacement badge card carries the replacement badge card fee; a customer-requested selection change beyond the included selection changes in the quarter carries the planogram change fee.

**F5 Early removal and zero fees.** A machine removed before the minimum term in calendar months after its installation date carries the early removal fee once; a fee whose model amount is 0.00 is never charged.

### Counting rules

- **Net vend value of the month**: vend values dated in the month, less return and vend error credit values dated in the month; shrink and fees excluded.
- **Relocations in the rolling 12 months**: the machine's completed relocations in the 12 calendar months ending on the relocation date, inclusive, in date order, including the relocation being charged.
- **Selection changes in the quarter**: the selection changes (adds, par changes and removals) asked for by the customer and dated in the calendar quarter of the change, up to and including the change being charged, in date then reference order.

### Shortfall fee per model

For every model the minimum is that model's minimum monthly usage and the cap is that model's monthly fee cap. The shortfall fee is the minimum less the net vend value, multiplied by the shortfall fee rate and divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent, and then held at the cap if it exceeds it. No fee arises when the net vend value is at or above the minimum.

### Hypothetical cases

| Minimum | Net vend value | Rate | Cap | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 20% | 300.00 | none (at the minimum) |
| 1000.00 | 999.99 | 20% | 300.00 | 0.002 rounds to 0.00 |
| 1000.00 | 400.00 | 20% | 300.00 | 120.00 |
| 3000.00 | 500.00 | 20% | 300.00 | 500.00 held at 300.00 |

A model with 1 included relocation charges no fee for the first relocation in the rolling 12 months and charges the second. All figures are illustrations.
